capabilities: : Display task calendar view within Obsidian
disambiguation: It is a bridge between Markdown tasks and external calendars, not a replacement for your primary calendar application.
extras: The plugin operates entirely offline and requires no network access for core functionality or license verification. Pro features require a one-time purchase.
intentEvidence: Turn dated Markdown tasks into a calendar you can actually use outside Obsidian.
problem: Users who manage tasks in Markdown need a way to view those tasks in a traditional calendar without relying on external sync services or manual data entry.
summary: Converts dated Markdown tasks into standard .ics calendar files, allowing users to view Obsidian tasks in external calendar applications.
